description: React component 'TopRecommendations' that fetches and displays top high-priority recommendations with loading, success, and error states. It includes subcomponents for severity badges, savings display, and skeleton loading rows. Implements logic for data fetching, filtering, and accessibility features.

methods.name: SeverityBadge
methods.description: Displays a badge indicating the severity level with appropriate color styling.

methods.name: SavingsPill
methods.description: Displays estimated savings as a styled pill.

methods.name: SkeletonRow
methods.description: Renders placeholder skeleton rows during loading state.
